lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments visible; spacing is approximately equidistant in the mid-torso (estimated 45-50 pixels) and becomes narrower and more irregular in the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 3rd line from the posterior, splitting in the upper third of the torso height; secondary merging segment visible at the dorsal terminus of the 7th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line is truncated, terminating in the upper dorsal quadrant; the anterior-most line is composed of two disconnected dashed segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density cluster comprising 2 distinct high-contrast circular spots located on the mid-lateral posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The 2 spots on the haunch exhibit a horizontal linear alignment parallel to the ventral torso line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyriform geometry with an initial posterior-lateral sweep followed by a medial-upward recurve; base-to-midpoint angle is approximately 50 degrees from the cranial axis.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 2.3 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately the distal 12% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Transverse white chevron across the nasal bridge and two distinct circular white markings on the lateral cheek region.
